yasmānniyatahetuko.pyāmayaḥ samyagbhiṣagādeśānuṣṭhānād upāttāyuḥsaṃskārāparikṣaye sati sahyavedanatāṃ pratipadyate |

tasmānna kasyāṃcid avasthāyām ātmavān hitāhitayos tulyadarśī syāt ||
subahuśo .pi ca bhidyamānā vyādhayo nijāgantutāṃ na vyabhicaranti |
tatra nijāstu doṣotthāsteṣu pūrvaṃ vātādayo vaiṣamyamāpadyante tato vyathābhinirvartate |
doṣavaiṣamyeṇaiva ca bahurūpā ruganubadhyate pravardhate ca |
evaṃ ca kṛtvā na doṣavyatirekeṇa rogānubandhaḥ kevalaṃ paurvāparye viśeṣaḥ |
tasmādekākārā eva rogāstathā ruksāmānyādasaṃkhyabhedā vā pratyekaṃ samutthānasthānasaṃsthānadharmanāmavedanā
yathaiva śakuniḥ sarvataḥ paripatan divasaṃ svāṃ chāyāṃ nātivartate |
yathā vā kṛtsnaṃ vikārajātaṃ vaiśvarūpyeṇa vyavasthitaṃ guṇatrayamavyatiricya vartate tathaivedamapi kṛtsnaṃ vikārajātaṃ
yathā ca vidyudvarṣādayo nabhasi bhavanti na tvavaśyaṃ nimittatastvavaśyamapi |
trividhaṃ tu nimittameṣām asātmyendriyārthasaṃyogaḥ prajñāparādhaḥ pariṇāmaśca |
te punaḥ pratyekam atiyogāyogamithyāyogabhedāt tridhā bhidyante |
tatra yathāsvaṃ cakṣurādīndriyāṇāṃ rūpādibhirarthairatisaṃsargo.tiyogaḥ alpaśo naiva vā saṃsargastvayogaḥ |
svabhāvādibhir āhārakalpanāviśeṣāyatanair apathyānāṃ rasānāmabhyavahārastathā snānādīnāṃ śītoṣṇādīnāṃ ca spṛśyānām
pariṇāmaḥ punaḥ kāla ucyate so.pi śītoṣṇavarṣabhedāttridhā |
